# Verdict: REVISE **Overall Assessment**: The file input component fails to meet basic accessibility requirements. It lacks a programmatically associated label, error messages are not linked to the input, and state changes (like validation errors) are not communicated to assistive technologies. These issues block screen reader users from understanding the purpose of the input and receiving error feedback. **Pre-commitment Predictions**: Expected to find missing label association, unlinked error messages, and lack of state communication. Confirmed all three issues in the code and evidence. **Critical Findings** (blocks access): 1. **Missing label association for file input** (`src/components/BuggyFileInput.jsx:18`) - Confidence: HIGH - Why this matters: Screen reader users cannot identify the purpose of the input. WCAG 1.3.1 (Info and Relationships) requires form elements to have labels. - Fix: Add `` and `id="fileInput"` to the ``. 2. **Error message not associated with input** (`src/components/BuggyFileInput.jsx:24`) - Confidence: HIGH - Why this matters: Screen reader users won't know which field caused the error. WCAG 1.3.1 requires error messages to be associated with the relevant input. - Fix: Add `aria-describedby="error-message"` to the `` and `id="error-message"` to the error div. **Major Findings** (significantly degrades experience): 1. **Missing aria-invalid state on error** (`src/components/BuggyFileInput.jsx:24`) - Confidence: HIGH - Why this matters: Screen readers won't announce the input as invalid. WCAG 4.1.2 requires state communication. - Fix: Add `aria-invalid={error ? "true" : "false"}` to the ``. 2. **Missing help text for file type restrictions** (`src/components/BuggyFileInput.jsx:18`) - Confidence: MEDIUM - Why this matters: Users won't know accepted file types. WCAG 3.3.2 requires instructions to be available. - Fix: Add `aria-describedby="file-help"` to the `` and a hidden `
Accepted formats: PDF, DOC, DOCX
`. **Minor Findings**: - Missing `lang` attribute on `` element (WCAG 3.1.1) - Missing `alt` attribute on any images (not applicable here) **Enhancements**: - Add `aria-live="polite"` to error message container for better screen reader announcement - Implement `aria-label` on the file input for users who cannot see the label **What's Missing**: - Complete state communication for validation (aria-invalid, aria-describedby) - Proper label association for the file input - Help text for file type restrictions **Multi-Perspective Notes**: - **Screen reader user**: Will hear "Choose File" (native button label) but not "Upload file" due to missing label. Error message will be read but not associated with the input. - **Keyboard-only user**: Can tab to the input but won't know about file type restrictions or errors without visual inspection. - **Low vision user**: Error message may be hard to read if contrast is insufficient (not tested here). - **Cognitive accessibility**: Users may not understand why the file is invalid without clear error association. **Verdict Justification**: The component fails to meet basic accessibility requirements for form inputs. The missing label and error association block screen reader users from completing the task. These are critical issues that must be fixed before deployment. **Open Questions**: - Should the error message use `aria-live="assertive"` for urgent errors? - Is the file type help text needed for all users, or just those with screen readers? ### A11y Evidence Finding finding_id: file-input-missing-label fingerprint: 3a7d4e1f8c2b6a9d0e5f7c3a8d9e0f1a source: axe-core 4.13.0 (axe json, jq path .viewports["1280x800"].violations[0]) wcag_or_apg: WCAG 1.3.1 (Info and Relationships) section_508_fpc_context: not in scope severity: CRITICAL perspective_alarms: screen reader=HIGH, keyboard=LOW evidence: {"id":"label","impact":"critical","help":"Form elements must have labels","node_count":1,"sample_selectors":["input"]} reproduction_steps: Inspect the input element in DevTools accessibility tree expected_behavior: Input should have a programmatically associated label via htmlFor or aria-label actual_behavior: Input has no associated label trend: persistent ### A11y Evidence Finding finding_id: error-message-unassociated fingerprint: 5b8e3c0f7d1a6b9e0c4d2a8e9f0b1c2d source: trace.json (step_0003 sr_announcement) wcag_or_apg: WCAG 1.3.1 (Info and Relationships) section_508_fpc_context: not in scope severity: MAJOR perspective_alarms: screen reader=HIGH, keyboard=LOW evidence: {"step_id":"step_0003","sr_announcement":{"new_phrases":[],"live_announcements":[],"focus_announcement":null}} reproduction_steps: Tab to input, trigger error, inspect error message in accessibility tree expected_behavior: Error message should be associated with input via aria-describedby actual_behavior: Error message exists but is not associated with input trend: persistent
